name: Hurley Metal Fabrication & MFG
old_description: Hurley Metal Fabrication & MFG specializes in critical tolerance projects at competitive pricing. Short runs, long runs, punching, forming, welding… Hurley can be your one source for all metal fabrication demands.
about:
Hurley Metal Fabrication & Manufacturing operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility in Windsor, Connecticut. The company has been in business since 1995, building a reputation as a job shop for critical-tolerance sheet metal work.

The shop provides a full range of sheet metal fabrication services, including fiber laser cutting up to 1.125-inch thick, five-axis water jet cutting up to six inches thick, tube laser cutting, press brake forming to 330 tons, punching, hardware insertion, plate rolling, and sawing with CNC gauging accuracy of 0.005 inch. Welding capabilities cover MIG, TIG, fiber optic laser, and advanced precision welding. Finishing options include polishing, brushing, coating, plating, deburring, and cleaning. The 15-plus technicians handle prototype through production volumes, producing frames, panels, tubing, tooling, computer chassis, enclosures, material handling equipment, stainless steel food processing equipment, and cosmetic and architectural projects.

Hurley serves commercial clients across architectural, automotive, and OEM product manufacturing sectors, with additional work in food processing and cosmetic industries.

The company emphasizes strong project management, consistent communication, quality craftsmanship, and top-of-the-line equipment as its differentiators, and offers expedited turnaround times, product traceability, and materials management through its Unitower storage system.

name: Hy-Ten Plastics Inc
old_description: Hy-Ten is a full service custom plastic injection molding supplier that specializes in tight tolerance plastic molding and related value added services. Serving the medical, electronic, industrial and consumer industries for 60 years, we provide plastic injection molding solutions in every point of the value chain — from concept through launch and sustaining supply — and strive to provide the resources that ensure your success. We have the expertise, partners and systems to provide robust design, quality tooling and precision injection molding for your company.
about:
Hy-Ten Plastics Inc operates from its headquarters and production facility in Milford, New Hampshire. The company has served the medical, electronic, industrial, and consumer industries for 60 years, specializing in tight-tolerance plastic injection molding and related value-added services. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed in the available information.

Hy-Ten provides full-service custom injection molding, from design and engineering through tooling, prototyping, and production. Its Milford facility houses 22 electric injection molding machines ranging from 55 to 385 tons, a certified Class 8 cleanroom, and a 3D CMM scanner for reverse engineering. The company offers scientific molding methodology, mold flow simulation, and 3D production prototyping via fused deposition modeling (FDM) with five material options. Value-added services include ultrasonic welding, machining, drilling and tapping, plating, printing, painting, custom packaging, barcoding, and vendor-managed inventory. Hy-Ten has produced millions of complex disposable medical parts and supports volumes from prototype to high-volume manufacturing.

Hy-Ten serves medical, electronic, industrial, and consumer markets. Medical customers include manufacturers of blood filtration devices, IV drip valves, and complex disposable assemblies. Electronic applications encompass hand-held printer assemblies, electronic and chemical analyzers, and wireless communication housings. Industrial projects have addressed molded-in bearings, thick-walled parts, and filtration system components.

Hy-Ten emphasizes in-house management of all services from design through manufacturing to control cost, quality, and lead times. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016. The company cites a culture of integrity, respect, and quality, with a focus on customer partnerships, continuous improvement, and business ethics as differentiators.

old_description: ICA Mid-Atlantic (formerly Cable Assembly, LLC) is a member of the ICA family of companies. Whatever your company makes, ICA makes the connections that bring it to life. ICA Holdings is one of the largest and most diverse manufacturers of specialty wire harnesses, cable assemblies and electromechanical assemblies in the US. Our strategic network of facilities in the US and Mexico enables diversified manufacturing capacity to meet the high-mix, low- and high-volume product needs of customers in dozens of end markets. Each of our manufacturing operations brings 20+ years of exceptional quotation and manufacturing engineering resources, service, and quality to address every aspect of your wire harness, cable assembly and electromechanical needs, from design to delivery.
about:
ICA Mid-Atlantic, located in Whitsett, North Carolina, traces its roots to 1988 when the facility was founded as Cable Assembly, LLC. Now a member of the ICA family of companies under ICA Holdings, the operation specializes in wire harness, cable assembly, and electromechanical manufacturing.

The company produces specialty wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and electromechanical assemblies using processes that include manufacturing engineering, electrical and mechanical engineering, CAD and 3D modeling, harness design software, automated CST machines, semi-automated assembly, hot stamp and ink-jet printing, ultrasonic splicing, ribbon cable notching and terminating, cable testing, and high-voltage testing. As part of the ICA family, it benefits from six strategically located facilities across the U.S.

ICA Mid-Atlantic serves customers in specialty vehicles, steam turbines, HVAC equipment, fuel dispensers, point-of-sale systems, wheelchair-accessible vehicles, material handling equipment, generators and compressors, energy management control, airline ground support equipment, and general industrial markets. Its client base includes Fortune 500 companies and multibillion-dollar international manufacturers.

The company emphasizes superior front-end support from design through delivery, an optimal balance of high quality and low cost designed into each product, state-of-the-art equipment, and a highly trained labor force to meet high-mix, low- and high-volume needs.

name: Idaho Hat Company
old_description: Since 2003, Idaho Hat Company has been serving Nampa and the Treasure Valley with quality hats and more. As a locally owned small business, we take pride in offering affordable prices and outstanding customer service that keeps our customers coming back.
about:
Idaho Hat Company was founded in 2003 in Nampa, Idaho, by a family with multi-generational experience in hat crafting, reshaping, and restoration. The shop operates from the front porch of the family home in downtown Nampa, serving the Treasure Valley region. Jorge, a key artisan, handles restoration and custom work.

The company produces many of the hats it sells in-house, while also carrying established brands such as Stetson, Resistol, American Hat Co., and Tony Lama boots. Services include hat shaping, cleaning, restoration, and custom hat and boot orders. The retail space offers felt, straw, palm leaf, and leather hats across styles from fedoras to golf hats, plus belts, wallets, and tack.

Customers range from local residents seeking everyday headwear to rodeo participants and fair-goers across the Treasure Valley. The shop also supports designers and artisans, and maintains a presence at community events. Prices start at $10, targeting both practical buyers and those looking for distinctive gifts.

The family-owned business emphasizes personalized service, community roots, and exclusive selections not found elsewhere. Its differentiation rests on decades of hands-on expertise, affordable pricing, and a commitment to building lasting relationships rather than one-time transactions.

name: Illinois Components
old_description: Since 1996, Illinois Components, Inc. has proudly served as a trusted provider of tape and reel services, with a specialization in surface mount taping. With a focus on precision and efficiency, we ensure that your components are securely packaged for automated assembly. Our commitment to excellence and attention to detail make us the preferred choice for surface-mount taping needs. Trust Illinois Components to continually produce products that you can truly depend on.
about:
Illinois Components, Inc. was founded in 1996 in Lombard, Illinois, by Tony and Keith Bondi, who serve as president and vice president respectively. The company began as a specialist in tape and reel services, focusing on surface mount taping for automated electronics assembly.

The firm provides a range of packaging and programming services for electronic components. Its core offerings include surface mount taping, radial and axial taping, tape and reel packaging, electronic component programming, cut and form operations, and inspection. Work is performed in a clean, modern facility using high-speed automated equipment that handles tape widths from 8 to 120 mm and reel diameters of 7, 13, 15, and 22 inches. The company also supplies metal stampings, spacers, and standoffs for the metals industry and offers custom carrier pocket designs and barcoded labeling.

Illinois Components serves the electronics manufacturing sector, handling all surface mount and through-hole devices, as well as the metals industry for spacers, stampings, screw-machine parts, and standoffs. Its customers are typically original equipment manufacturers and contract assemblers seeking to streamline production with reliable, standards-compliant packaging.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround, quoting completion from inception to delivery in one week or less for custom solutions. It adheres to EIA taping standards and ESD procedures, and differentiates itself through custom pocket design, quick-turn programming, and a customer-centric approach that prioritizes precision and on-time delivery.

name: Imperium Cable
old_description: Imperium Cable LLC is a US company, headquartered in Michigan, focusing on the North American Commercial, Industrial, Solar and Residential marketplaces. Imperium Cable products are sold through the electrical distribution network utilizing a sales network of knowledgeable high quality electrical manufacturers’ representatives.
about:
Imperium Cable LLC is a U.S. company headquartered in Troy, Michigan, serving the North American commercial, industrial, solar, and residential markets. The company sells its products through an electrical distribution network supported by a roster of manufacturers’ representatives covering most of the United States.

Its product line spans low- and medium-voltage cables in single- and multi-conductor configurations, using copper or aluminum conductors with thermoplastic or thermosetting insulation (XLP/EPR) and jackets of PVC, PE, CPE, or cross-linked materials. Medium-voltage cables are tested to AEIC requirements and certified by a independent high-voltage laboratory.

The commercial segment targets hotels, offices, hospitals, schools, shopping centers, mixed-use communities, underground parking garages, and apartments. The industrial segment addresses wastewater treatment plants, petrochemical facilities, pulp and paper mills, pharmaceutical plants, oil and gas operations, mining, and marine applications. Residential offerings include NM-B nonmetallic sheathed cable, while the solar line provides UL-listed PV wire in copper and aluminum at 600 V and 2000 V ratings.

The company emphasizes the breadth of its product line, the scale and certification of its manufacturing footprint, and the third-party validation of its medium-voltage cables as key differentiators.

name: In Style USA
old_description: As a member of the Council of Fashion Designers of America since 2013, In Style USA has advocated for designers both big and small. Creating thoughtful and intuitive solutions for manufacturing the finest garments in NYC. In Style USA was the recipient of the inaugural grant of Fashion Manufacturing Initiative. This program was created through a partnership between the CFDA and New York City Economic Development Corporation to help preserve manufacturing in New York City. As leaders in the NYC Garment industry, In Style USA strives to excel and continue to grow as the premier resource for designers.
about:
In Style USA was founded in 2013 in New York City’s Garment District by Tina Yu, a designer and patternmaker from a multi-generational fashion manufacturing family. After launching her own eveningwear collection in Toronto, Yu relocated to New York and established the atelier, which quickly attracted clients such as Bill Blass and Oscar de la Renta. James Mallon, a veteran of Oxford Industries and former label owner, later joined as a partner, adding global sourcing expertise.

The company provides full-package garment development and production from a roughly 10,000-square-foot facility housing more than 60 sewing machines and two on-site cutting tables. Services span product review and consultation, fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making, garment fitting, sample making, product development, resource guidance, sewing and hand sewing, production management, packaging, and design and branding. The vertical operation moves designs from concept through bulk production under one roof.

In Style USA serves fashion designers and apparel brands ranging from established houses to emerging labels. Its client roster has included names like Bill Blass and Oscar de la Renta, and its garments are sold at top retail accounts worldwide. The firm has been a member of the Council of Fashion Designers of America since 2013 and was the inaugural recipient of the Fashion Manufacturing Initiative grant, a program backed by the CFDA and the New York City Economic Development Corporation.

The company emphasizes knowledge sharing and vertical integration as its differentiators. In Style USA also positions itself as a steward of New York City manufacturing, aiming to elevate and expand the Garment District as a resource for fashion designers.

Incipio Devices is an orthopedic device company based in Huntington, Indiana, with an additional office in St-Blaise, Switzerland. The company was founded by a group of industry experts who aimed to provide solution-driven approaches to commercial products, contract manufacturing, and development. Incipio serves the orthopedic and broader medical device industries. Its customer base includes surgeons seeking custom solutions, entrepreneurs launching new devices, and established orthopedic companies requiring contract manufacturing or development support. The firm emphasizes end-to-end collaboration from concept through manufacturing and release.

According to the company, its differentiation lies in a solution-driven mindset that integrates commercial product development with contract manufacturing. Its quality policy commits to consistently meeting or exceeding customer, statutory, and regulatory requirements while pursuing ever-improving quality through programs that enable each employee to do the job right the first time.

EMF Corporation was established in 1970 in Angola, Indiana, and operates four manufacturing facilities across Indiana, Kentucky, and Mississippi. The company serves customers nationwide and throughout North America from its Midwestern and Southern U.S. locations.

The company produces custom wire harnesses, discrete wire harnesses, injection-molded connectors, fluorescent lamp holders, lead wires, electronic cables, specialty connectors, receptacles, and junctions. Its capabilities include precision injection molding, custom electrical system engineering, prototyping, tooling, and full production runs. A sizable catalog of standard components supports custom assembly work, and the firm also manufactures electrical box builds, DC barrel connectors, extension cords, and shelf light harnesses.

EMF serves industries including retail, manufacturing, vending, refrigeration, lighting, electric motors, electrical controls, HVAC, automotive, and appliances. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to end-users across North America seeking custom electrical wiring systems and molded connectors.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement programs consistent with ISO standards, and most products carry UL and CSA recognition. Management describes a turnkey approach from engineering through production, with a willingness to tackle unusual or challenging projects without restrictions on size, type, or scope.
